svg.title: Density, cumulative, survival and quantile — one Normal example
svg.desc: For Z standard Normal at z=1: density 0.241971, cumulative area 0.841345, survival area 0.158655, and inverse cumulative at the full precision cumulative probability returns approximately 1. Density is height, probability is area. Survival means P(Z greater than z).

g.text: One distribution. Four ways to read it.
Z ~ Normal(0, 1) • threshold z = 1 • p = F(1), q = S(1)
Same model and threshold throughout. Probabilities shown to 6 decimals; calculations use full precision.
For continuous Z: P(Z = 1) = 0; probability is an area. For discrete X: PMF(k) = P(X = k).
Tail convention: S(x) = P(X > x) = 1 − F(x). Use direct Survival for small upper tails.
Plots show finite windows; area labels include the full infinite tails. Quantile endpoints are unbounded.
Illustration of implemented APIs, not Excel certification. Availability and valid domains vary by operation.
